description: Call before shipping one product that bundles code, data, fonts or media under different licenses. Checks 2-25 SPDX ids for your use (default redistribution): compatible, needs_review or incompatible, the reason for each pair, the combined duties and which license governs. Free, no key. Call with {"licenses": ["MIT", "GPL-3.0-only", "CC-BY-NC-4.0"], "intended_use": {"redistribution": true, "commercial_use": true}}.

intended_use.description: Intended use: every true flag is a right the check must find documented; omitted flags are false; unknown fields are refused. For instance {"commercial_use":true,"deployment":true,"attribution_planned":true,"duration_days":365}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK

name: license_compatibility
title: Can these licenses be combined?
